title: Review Disposition Receipt (v1)
description: THREAD-reply marker recording WHY a review thread was resolved or deliberately kept open. Embedded in a pull-request review-comment reply as `<!-- disposition:v1 {json} -->` and posted by scripts/reviews/disposition (the ONLY sanctioned thread-transition path — it posts this reply, then applies the marker's thread_transition). The check-pr-review-convergence closeout reads these to compute dispositions_missing_marker, followups_without_issue, unreachable_fix_commits, and the writer set (#3693 R1). Class-specific evidence is required: fixed→commit, refuted→argument, superseded→superseded_by, post-merge-follow-up→issue+argument, current-blocker→argument, blocked-by-prerequisite→issue+argument, not-proven→argument. The legacy class `follow-up` is retained in the enum only so historical markers remain valid; scripts/reviews/disposition rejects it for new dispositions because it does not say whether the current claim is satisfied or still blocked (#13342).

thread_id.description: The review thread this disposition resolves or keeps open.

by.description: Identity of the disposer (a member of the writer set).

head.description: The PR headRefOid this disposition was posted at.

thread_transition.description: The transition scripts/reviews/disposition applies after posting: resolve for terminal classes, keep_open for live blockers and NOT_PROVEN. Optional only because historical v1 markers predate the field.

evidence.description: Class-specific evidence. Exactly the field for the class is required.

commit.description: fixed: the SHA that fixed it (must be reachable from head).

argument.description: refuted: why the finding does not hold; current-blocker/blocked-by-prerequisite: why the defect remains current; not-proven: the missing or contradictory evidence; post-merge-follow-up: why the current claim is already satisfied.

superseded_by.description: superseded: the PR/issue/commit that supersedes it.

issue.description: post-merge-follow-up / blocked-by-prerequisite / legacy follow-up: the tracking issue number.
